purpose: TC-Stereo as the integrated-architecture reference on identical frames and GT

temporal_path_disabled.reason: this run reports TC-Stereo's single-frame stereo path by choice of entry point. Its temporal path warps the previous disparity by a rigid 6-DoF reprojection from per-frame pose, intrinsics and baseline; SCARED-C does supply corrected per-frame poses, so the path is runnable and is run separately by run_tcstereo_temporal.py
temporal_path_disabled.consequence: an integrated-architecture reference, not a temporal rival

correction.what_was_wrong: this manifest justified disabling the temporal path by asserting that SCARED-C provides no per-frame pose. It does. The claim was retracted in the paper, the runner's docstring and here.
correction.what_changed: the justification only. No metric, frame, support or checkpoint in this run depends on it, so the numbers stand unaltered.
